Line: Ooh, fresh snacks! I mean... friends!
Well well well. Who's out past bedtime?
I smell someone who forgot to go home.
Found you! Your hiding is very bad.
Hey! Wait up! I just want to play!
Is that a tiny friend? It IS! Hi!!
Run run run! This is the fun part!
You call that running? My nap is faster.
Tag! Wait, I didn't touch you. Tag again!
Your little legs are SO cute when they panic.
I'm not chasing, I'm escorting. Loudly.
Left! No, right! Ha, wrong both times!
Don't drop your rocks! Actually, do.
Keep going, the garden misses you!
Ooh, SO close, {Target}! I felt your hair wiggle!
Boop! Almost got the boop in.
That was a warning sniff. Next is a hug.
Hey, no fair dodging! Who taught you that?
My nose touched your shoe, {Target}. That counts.
Heh. Your heart is racing, I can hear it.
Aww, you went inside. Boring!
Safe and sound. For NOW.
Fine, hide in your cute little garden.
You run home every time. I see you.
Nice house. Be a shame if I... looked at it.
Okay okay, you win this round, tiny.
Come out and play!
Knock knock. It's me. Big me.
Your fence is rude and so are you.
I can wait. I'm VERY good at waiting.
Is that a cookpot? Make me something!
Just one toe out. One. I'll be nice.
I'm not stuck. I'm choosing to be out here.
Hellooo? Anybody want a ride? On my teeth?
Ugh, fine. I'm bored anyway.
Nap time. You got lucky, tiny.
I'm leaving because I WANT to. Bye.
This isn't over! It's just... paused.
Tell your dinos I said hi. Grr.
Keep the garden warm. I'll be back.
Guess who's baaack!
Missed me? I missed you. Hungrily.
Your circle got bigger. Mine did too.
Round two! I stretched this time.
Did you miss my lovely voice?
I brought my running legs today.
Mmm, crunchy! Okay, I'm full. Bye!
One snack is plenty. Thanks for the gift!
Brave little one. Tasty little one.
Your friends ran off. Rude of them, honestly.
Delicious! That's all I wanted. Toodles!
Next time send TWO newbies. Kidding. Maybe.
Where you going, {Target}? Huh? Where you going?
Hey {Target}! Yes YOU! You're my favorite!
Don't look back, it just makes me faster.
I picked you special. Feel honored!
Your friends left you. I never would.
You're the slowest one. That's why I love you.
Run, buddy, run! I'm right behind you!
Where you going? The fun is right HERE!
Why you running, {Target}?
Why you running, huh? Why you running?
Where you going? Huh? Huh?
What's the rush, {Target}? Huh?
Who you running from? Me? Why me?
Why you scared, huh? I'm friendly!
Where you think you're going, huh?
Slow down! Why you so fast, huh?
You going home? Already? Why?
Hey. Hey. {Target}. Where you going?
Why you hiding, huh? I see you!
You leaving? Huh? Without me?
